seo.title: Fastrac Charters & Cruises — Sunset, Dinner & Themed Cruises and Private Charters on Lake Texoma
seo.description: Lake Texoma's only cruise and charter service. Public sunset, dinner, lake-history, eagle-watching and murder-mystery cruises aboard the Island Girl and Sight-Sea-Er II, private charters for 2–70, Lake Day beach trips and the Texoma Water Taxi. Departing Lighthouse Marina, Pottsboro. Tickets on texomadestinations.com.

home.heroKicker: The Most Amazing way to see Lake Texoma
home.heroTitle: Catch a sunset. Catch some fun.
home.heroSubtitle: Lake Texoma's only cruise and charter service — ticketed sunset and dinner cruises nearly year-round, private charters for two to seventy, and the water taxi that gets you to the islands.

intro.title: The lake is better from the water
body: Fastrac has run Lake Texoma's public cruises and private charters from the Lighthouse Marina charter dock for years. In peak season there's a cruise every Friday and Saturday night; in winter the eagle-watching breakfast cruises sell out. The 90-minute Lake Tour is a narrated history of the lake — the marinas, the million-dollar homes, Denison Dam and the islands.

Our fleet fits any group: the Island Girl, Texoma's largest party boat with a climate-controlled cabin and two decks; the Sight-Sea-Er II, a 55-foot tritoon with a galley and restroom; the covered Mellow Yellow and the nimble Jolt for water-taxi runs and small charters; and the Last Call yacht for ten. Every cruise is BYOB, and every one is captained by a licensed USCG captain.

features.title: Sunset & dinner cruises
features.body: Friday and Saturday evenings in season. The 90-minute Sunset Cruise aboard the Sight-Sea-Er II is $35 for all ages; the Dinner Cruise on the Island Girl adds a full dinner, dessert and soft drinks for $60 (kids 3–12 $40). BYOB.

features.title: Lake Tour Experience
features.body: A narrated 90-minute history tour — $30 per person, or private on the Mellow Yellow (up to 18) or Sight-Sea-Er (up to 36). Add a boxed lunch.

features.title: Themed cruises
features.body: Murder Mystery dinner cruises (adults, $79), Eagle Watching Breakfast cruises in January and February ($59), Cupid's Arrow for Valentine's, Mother's Day brunch, Sights & Sips, and the kids' Discovering Texie cruise with Lake Texoma's dragon mascot.

features.title: Private charters
features.body: Weddings and receptions, corporate outings, reunions, memorials, birthdays. Pick the date, time, menu and boat; we bring the captain, crew and wait service. Island Girl from $500/hr, Sight-Sea-Er II from $350/hr.

features.title: Lake Day & Boat Ride experiences
features.body: Four hours to a secluded beach with captain and crew, kayaks and catering as add-ons — $1,000 for up to 12, $40 per extra guest to 36. Or a private Boat Ride for up to six from $150 an hour with your own itinerary.

features.title: Texoma Water Taxi
features.body: Like Uber, on the water. $25 per person each way between Highport Marina and the islands, or $100 an hour private for up to six. Text or call for a pickup at any marina or your dock, sunrise to sunset.

sections.title: Public cruises
body: Ticketed cruises run nearly year-round, with something every Friday and Saturday night in peak season (May–September) unless the boat is privately chartered. The schedule is posted roughly a month ahead — April's cruises appear in March.

Sunset Cruise — 1.5 hours on the Sight-Sea-Er II, $35 all ages, snacks sold aboard. Dinner Cruise — 1.5 hours on the Island Girl with dinner, dessert and soft drinks, $60 adults / $40 kids 3–12. Lake Tour — 90 narrated minutes, $30. Sights & Sips — light snacks and drinks, $49 / $39 under 12. All BYOB for adult beverages.

sections.title: Themed & seasonal cruises
body: Eagle Watching Breakfast Cruises (January–February, Saturdays and select Sundays, $59, kids 3 and under free) — hot breakfast, mimosa setups and hundreds of wintering eagles. Murder Mystery Cruises ($79, adults only) with rotating plots from 1920s mob to 1980s Wall Street. Cupid's Arrow dinner cruise for Valentine's, Mother's Day Brunch, and the family Discovering Texie Cruise with Lake Texoma's dragon.

sections.title: Private charters
body: Choose the boat, the date, the menu and the guest list. The Island Girl (up to 70, climate-controlled interior, bathrooms aboard, two decks, catering partners and rotating menus) from $500 an hour. The Sight-Sea-Er II (55-foot tritoon, galley, restroom, up to 36) from $350 an hour. The Last Call 55-foot yacht for up to ten, with appetizer, barbecue or taco-bar menus, from $900 for two hours — or the romantic four-course version for two at $450.
Private charters require 14 days' notice to cancel without penalty.

sections.title: Lake Day, Boat Rides & Water Taxi
body: Lake Day Experience: four hours to a secluded beach on the Sight-Sea-Er or Mellow Yellow with captain and crew — $1,000 for up to 12, $40 per additional guest up to 36, kayaks and catering optional. Boat Ride Experience: one to six hours for up to six with your own itinerary, $150 an hour. Texoma Water Taxi: $25 per person each way between Highport Marina and the islands, or $100 an hour private for up to six, sunrise to sunset.

plan.title: Boarding at Lighthouse Marina
plan.subtitle: 300 Lighthouse Drive, Pottsboro — the charter dock beside the marina store.

arrival.title: Before you board
body: Boarding opens 15 minutes before departure and the boat leaves promptly at the scheduled time — please allow time for parking and the walk to the dock. Bring your ticket on your phone; a passenger manifest is required for every cruise.

Cruises depart rain or shine. If the captain cancels for weather (high wind, lightning), you receive a full refund less any expenses incurred. Dress is casual to semi-casual; bring a layer for the top deck.

directions: From Pottsboro, SH 289 north about 6 miles; Lighthouse Drive is on the left just past the Tackle Box.
Park in the main resort lot and walk down to the charter dock next to the fuel dock.
Some Boat Ride departures leave from Highport Marina (120 Texoma Harbor Rd) — your confirmation will say so.
Staying the night? Lighthouse cabins are a two-minute walk from the dock.

groups.title: Private charters for two to seventy
groups.subtitle: Corporate events, weddings and receptions, celebrations, reunions and parties — on the water, with a crew that has done this a thousand times.
intro: Tell us the occasion and the headcount and we'll match the boat: the Island Girl for big parties and receptions, the Sight-Sea-Er II for groups up to 36 who want a galley aboard, the Last Call yacht for an intimate ten, or the Mellow Yellow for a laid-back eighteen. Every charter includes captain, crew and fuel; catering runs from appetizers to plated dinners, and we can add a DJ, live music or a theme.

Charters book around the public schedule, so weekend evenings in summer go first. Private charters require 14 days' notice to cancel without penalty. Send a quote request and our events team will reply with dates and options.
